title: Realization embeddings of the rank two Racah algebra into the rank two Jacobi algebra
summary: We construct an explicit embedding of the rank two Racah algebra $\mathfrak{R}_2$ into the rank two Jacobi algebra $\mathfrak{J}_2$. Working in the differential model of $\mathfrak{J}_2$ on the triangle, we recall that the subalgebra structure of $\mathfrak{J}_2$ is organized by a pentagon whose four upper edges carry rank one Jacobi algebras and whose base carries a rank one Racah algebra. Promoting the two multiplication operators to Racah type generators by tridiagonalization turns every edge of the pentagon into a rank one Racah algebra and realizes $\mathfrak{R}_2$ inside…
